meaning:
ὀχλέω, -ῶ
(ὄχλος), [in LXX: Tob.6:7, 3Ma.5:41 * ;]
to move, disturb; hence, generally, to trouble, vex: pass., Act.5:6 (act. absol., = pass., to be in a tumult, 3Mac, l.with; cf. ἐν-, παρ-εν-οχλέω, and see MM, xviii).†
(AS)
